location_exception_reason: LGSF is a nationwide construction technology with no GI-tagged or region-specific origin requirement; buyer decisions are driven by structural performance, compliance (BIS/BMTPC), and system capability, not geographic source.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, EPC) in LGSF titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently, and removing these words leaves the product description complete and unambiguous.
